content: Kuziga kukwânîne barhulole nka barhumisi ba Kristu, nk’abarhumirwe naye okugabira abantu amahwe ga Nyamuzinda
Nêci, bahûna abarhumisi, kuli kubà nkubagirwa.
Niehe ntankababala erhi, nankaderhwa mwinjà erhi mubî ninyu, nîsi erhi aha ngombe y’abantu. Nâni niene ntankacîtwîra olubanja.
Omurhima gwâni ntâco guntumuzize, ci arhali kwo kuderha oku ndi mwêru-kwêru. Omutwî w’emmanja wâni, ye Nyakasane.

Kuziga murhatwaga olubanja lwa bene dubaduba. Muleke Nyakasane ayishe, ye wash’imoleka ebifulike omu mwizimya, anabishûle emihigo eri omu murhima. Okubundi ngasi muguma ayish’ihâbwa na Nyamuzinda obukuze bumukwânîne.

Muli ebyo byoshi, bene wîrhu, nacîjizire lwîganyo rhwe n’Apolo erhi mwe murhuma. Nalonzagya nti murhuyigirekwo ogu mugani: «Ntâco kulusha ebyayandisirwe», lyo harhajira owacîbonera muguma mpu alushire owundi;
Ndi wakuhâga ecirhuma orhumânini n’abandi? Cici ojira orhahâbagwa? N’a­kabà kuhâbwa wacihâbagwa, câ cirhuma walimbira abandi nka kulya arhali kuhâbwa wahâbagwa?
Lêro mukolaga muyigusire! Lêro mukolaga muli bagale! Buzira rhwe mukola bâmi! Ciru mucibâga bâmi, nîrhu rhukayîma haguma ninyu!
Bulya, kwo ncîkebirwe, Nyamuzinda arhujizire bikabulirwa, rhwe ntumwa, nk’abatwîrîrwe okufà. Nêci, rhwabîre masheka omu masù g’igulu na bamalahika n’abantu:
Rhwono rhuli basirhe erhi Kristu orhuma, ninyu muli bîrhonzi muli Kristu; rhwono rhuli ngonyi, ninyu muli ba-misî; mwoyo muli bakengwa, nîrhu bagaye.
Ciru na buno rhuli bufà n’ishali, n’enyôrha, n’okubula ehi rhucîbwîsire; rhudwîrhe rhwalibuzibwa, na ntâho rhujira rhwankahanda.
Rhudwîrhe rhwarhindibuka n’okukola n’enfune zîrhu. Badwîrhe barhujâcira, nîrhu rhubahè obwangà; badwîrhe barhulibuza, nîrhu rhucîhumbire;
badwîrhe barhubêshera, nîrhu rhwanarhûliriza. Rhwabirage nka bijandagwa by’igulu na nka camvu ca boshi kuhika ene.
Ntayandisiri ebyo nti mmubonêse nshonyi, ci kuderha nti mmukalihire kulya omuntu akalihira abâna bâge bazigirwa.
Bulya ciru wankajira balezi bihumbi n’ebihumbi muli Kristu, basho barhali banga. Nêci, niene nammuburhaga n’Emyanzi y’Akalembe muli Yezu Kristu.
Mmuhûnyire, mâshi mwe mukonkwa, mushimbe olwiganyo lwâni.

Co canarhumaga nammurhumira Timoteyo, mugala wâni ntonya n’okwânîne okucîkubagirwa muli Nyakasane; a­mmukengêza oku nyôrha n’oku nyigîriza muli Kristu, kulya nanyigîriza hoshi hoshi omu Ekleziya zoshi.
Erhi bacîkêbwa mpu nkaba ntayisha emwinyu, baguma babirigirhana n’obucîbone.
Cikwône ndi hôfi h’okummuyishira, Nyakasane akulonza; niene namanya abo babirigirhîne n’obucîbone, nabamanyira kw’ebi bankahash’ijira, ci arhali oku binwa byâbo.
Bulya Obwâmi bwa Nyamuzinda burhaba omu binwa, ci omu bijiro.
Cici mucîshozire? Ka mulonzize mmuyishire n’eminyuli, nîsi erhi mulonzize nyishe n’obuzigire n’omurhima gw’obutûdu?

footnotes.text: 4, 1 Amahwe ga Nyamuzinda bwo buhirhi bwoshi bw’enyigîrizo n’obuzîne Larha Nnâmahanga amanyîsize anashobôza abantu. Omu katekisimu bakâg’idôsa, mpu: «Myanzi ya Kalembe ehi Yezu arhubwîzire?» Ishuzo, mpu: «Emyanzi y’Akalembe Yezu arhubwîzire yeyi: Nyamuzinda ye Sho omuzigira, alonzize muyôrhe nka bâna bâge hano igulu.»
